hunks.baseline: Shao Shen realized it for the first time.
hunks.sol: Shao Shen realized something for the first time.

hunks.baseline: If you witnessed an airplane diving toward the ground with both wings engulfed in flames, you would be seized by a terror that transcended species.
hunks.sol: The sight of an airplane diving toward the ground with both wings engulfed in flames inspired terror that transcended species.

hunks.baseline: The supposedly fearsome ogres screamed, and the Trolls shrieked.
hunks.sol: The supposedly ferocious ogres and Trolls screamed.

hunks.baseline: Even the notoriously sluggish Ghouls ran so fast that sweat broke out on the soles of their feet.
hunks.sol: Even the notoriously sluggish Ghouls ran hard enough to work up a sweat on the soles of their feet.

hunks.baseline: The monsters that could scream were the lucky ones.
hunks.sol: The monsters capable of screaming were the lucky ones.

hunks.baseline: Shao Shen and most of the others could do nothing but stare at the airplane hurtling toward the ground, frozen like stone statues.
hunks.sol: Shao Shen and most of the others could only stand frozen like statues, staring at the airplane hurtling toward the ground.

hunks.baseline: His feet and hands would not move.
hunks.sol: His hands and feet refused to move.

hunks.baseline: More importantly, Shao Shen and the Hunters of the Public Security Armed Forces Department were surrounded in the middle of the battlefield. They were not even given the chance to escape.
hunks.sol: More importantly, Shao Shen and the Hunters of the Public Security Armed Forces Department were surrounded in the middle of the battlefield. They had no chance to escape.

hunks.baseline: And that earth-shaking collision began at the rear of the monster army, which had been scattering like a swarm of ants.
hunks.sol: The earth-shaking collision began at the rear of the monster army as it scattered like a swarm of ants.

hunks.baseline: Green monster blood sprayed like fountains, while limbs of every size flew in all directions.
hunks.sol: Green monster blood sprayed like fountains, and limbs of every size flew in all directions.

hunks.baseline: *W-What is this…?*
hunks.sol: *W-What the hell is this…?*

hunks.baseline: No matter how powerful the monsters’ physical defenses were, there were limits. Nothing could stop the airplane after it had transformed into a monster blender.
hunks.sol: No matter how powerful the monsters’ physical defenses were, they had their limits. Nothing could stop the airplane now that it had transformed into a monster blender.

hunks.baseline: The monsters’ screams were buried beneath the grisly sounds of flesh being torn apart. It was a scene of carnage beyond anything they had ever seen or heard.
hunks.sol: The monsters’ screams vanished beneath the grisly sounds of flesh being torn apart. It was a scene of carnage beyond anything they had ever seen or heard.

hunks.baseline: The unmistakable language of their homeland reached them even in the midst of all this chaos. The Hunters of the Public Security Armed Forces Department had one word flash through their minds: *reinforcements.*
hunks.sol: Even amid all this chaos, they could clearly hear their native language. A single word flashed through the minds of the Public Security Armed Forces Department Hunters.
*Reinforcements.*

hunks.baseline: The powerful mana carried in that voice. The person was unquestionably an S-rank Hunter.
hunks.sol: The voice carried tremendous mana. The speaker was unquestionably an S-rank Hunter.

hunks.baseline: “Go for it! Airplane!”
hunks.sol: “Go for it! Airplaaaaane!”

hunks.baseline: And definitely a slightly insane S-rank Hunter.
hunks.sol: And unquestionably a slightly insane S-rank Hunter.

hunks.baseline: *To think he’d resort to a tactic those island bastards used back in World War II. Did he not consider that his own allies might die?*
hunks.sol: *To think he’d resort to a tactic those island bastards used in World War II. Did he not consider that his own allies might die?*

hunks.baseline: The question suddenly occurred to Shao Shen. But it was about to become irrelevant to him.
hunks.sol: The question suddenly occurred to Shao Shen, but it was about to become irrelevant.

hunks.baseline: The gigantic steel hulk that had ground its way across half the battlefield was now charging straight toward him and the Hunters.
hunks.sol: The gigantic steel hulk that had ground its way across half the battlefield was now charging straight toward him and the other Hunters.

hunks.baseline: Shao Shen forgot the humans right in front of him and drove his dagger into a monster barreling toward him.
hunks.sol: Forgetting the humans right in front of him, Shao Shen drove his dagger into a monster that barreled into him.

hunks.baseline: Unable to move even one step because monsters were surging in from every direction, Shao Shen felt the crushing weight descending upon him and shouted.
hunks.sol: He could not move a single step with monsters surging in from every direction. As the crushing weight fell upon him, Shao Shen shouted.

hunks.baseline: He was right. The battle was not over yet. A Hunter was someone who had to kill monsters until the final moment, until their own breath ran out.
hunks.sol: That was right. The battle was not over yet. A Hunter was someone who killed monsters until the very last moment—until their dying breath.

hunks.baseline: With lightning-fast skill, Shao Shen drove his dagger into the back of a fleeing ogre’s head, then drew a deep breath.
hunks.sol: With lightning-fast skill, Shao Shen buried his dagger in the back of a fleeing ogre’s head, then drew a deep breath.

hunks.baseline: The airplane’s massive body had already reached a point less than twenty meters away.
hunks.sol: The airplane’s massive body was already less than twenty meters away.

hunks.baseline: Its speed had decreased considerably from before, but with everyone trapped in place, avoiding it seemed impossible.
hunks.sol: It had slowed considerably, but with everyone trapped in place, avoiding it seemed impossible.

hunks.baseline: Drenched in a sticky liquid that he assumed was blood, Shao Shen thought:
hunks.sol: Drenched in a sticky liquid he assumed was blood, Shao Shen thought:

hunks.baseline: *…“Whew”?*
hunks.sol: *…Heave-ho?*

hunks.baseline: Wasn’t it usually more of an “Aaaah”?
hunks.sol: Wasn’t a person’s dying cry usually more like “Aaaah”?

hunks.baseline: The strange sound was an odd choice for a dying cry, so Shao Shen slowly raised his eyelids.
hunks.sol: It was a strange sound to make at the moment of death. Shao Shen cautiously opened his eyes.

hunks.baseline: And at last, he saw it.
hunks.sol: At last, he saw it.

hunks.baseline: A few steps away, the airplane had come to a complete stop. Two men were standing beside it, chatting casually.
hunks.sol: The airplane had stopped dead only a few steps away. Two men stood beside it, chatting casually.

hunks.baseline: “……They would have died if not for the Barrier magic.”
hunks.sol: “……They would have died if not for the Barrier spell.”

terminology_alerts.message: preferred glossary term appears in BASE but not SOL for this hunk

hunks.baseline: “Then carry them out, Team Leader Choi. Oh, right. Is that bastard who called us chinks earlier alive, too?”
hunks.sol: “Then carry them out, Team Leader Choi. Oh, right. Is that bastard who called us *bangzi* earlier still alive?”

hunks.baseline: “Then keep a close eye on that bastard. I’m going to give him hell for it when we head back.”
hunks.sol: “Then keep a close eye on that bastard. I’m going to give him hell for it the whole way back.”

hunks.baseline: Who, when, where, what, how, and why. It was such a bizarre sight that even the six fundamental questions could not organize it.
hunks.sol: Who, when, where, what, why, and how—this bizarre sight defied even the five Ws and one H.

terminology_alerts.message: preferred glossary term appears in BASE but not SOL for this hunk

hunks.baseline: *How did the airplane suddenly stop, and who are those people? Were they not Hunters sent by the Central Military Commission?*
hunks.sol: *How did the airplane suddenly stop, and who are those people? Weren’t they Hunters sent by the Central Military Commission?*

hunks.baseline: The two men were even speaking in a different language.
hunks.sol: The two men were even speaking in another language.

hunks.baseline: Shao Shen could not understand the words of the clean-cut man who looked like a young master, but he knew what country the language belonged to.
hunks.sol: Shao Shen could not understand the clean-cut man who looked like a young master, but he knew what language the man was speaking.

hunks.baseline: Korea, their longtime neighbor.
hunks.sol: It belonged to Korea, their longtime neighbor.

hunks.baseline: *Wait. If he’s Korean…!*
hunks.sol: *Wait. If they’re Korean…!*

hunks.baseline: Relief and hope coursed through Shao Shen’s entire body, making him tremble.
hunks.sol: Relief and hope washed over Shao Shen, making his entire body tremble.

hunks.baseline: *How on earth does a Chinese person know about Lord Fuck?*
hunks.sol: *How the hell does a Chinese guy know about Lord Fuck?*

hunks.baseline: Articles about me had caused a brief stir in the foreign media, but I never expected my nickname to spread this far.
hunks.sol: Articles about me had caused a brief stir in the foreign media, but I never expected even that nickname to spread this far.

hunks.baseline: If I ever went to the United States, some huge Yankee bros might approach me with beer bottles and act like they knew me.
hunks.sol: If I ever went to the United States, some huge Yankee bros might walk up to me holding beer bottles and act like they knew me.

hunks.baseline: *I’m fine, thanks. Fuck. What kind of deranged bastards came up with a nickname like this?*
hunks.sol: *I’m fine, thank you. Fuck. What kind of deranged bastards came up with a nickname like this?*

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi, who had tied up the unconscious flight attendants like a string of dried fish, and the Skeleton Warlord, who I had shoved into my Inventory, answered me.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi, who had strung the unconscious flight attendants together like dried fish, and the Skeleton Warlord, whom I had shoved into my Inventory, both answered me.

hunks.baseline: —You wicked human. This commander finds this place quite pleasing. It feels familiar and even nostalgic.
hunks.sol: —You wicked human. This commander rather likes this place. It feels familiar and comforting.

hunks.baseline: The fact that a named undead monster—something that could be called death itself—was pleased by the sight said it all.
hunks.sol: The fact that a named undead monster—death itself, for all intents and purposes—found the sight pleasing said more than enough.

hunks.baseline: As if responding to my complaint, the System notification rang.
hunks.sol: As if responding to my complaint, a System notification rang.

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi was a clever man. Learning the Jin Family’s Cultivation Technique had made him incomparably stronger than before, but he would never try to show off.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi was a smart man. Learning the Jin Family’s Cultivation Technique had made him incomparably stronger than before, but he would never show off.

hunks.baseline: “Yes, y-yes, Mr. Jin.”
hunks.sol: “Y-Yes, Mr. Jin.”

hunks.baseline: I looked the young man who had answered so quickly up and down.
hunks.sol: I looked the young man up and down as he snapped to attention.

hunks.baseline: His face was young, but he was obviously a Hunter. A powerful one, too—probably around A-rank. Unlike the surrounding Hunters, who all wore identical armor as if they had been stamped out in a factory, he also had a red insignia on his shoulder.
hunks.sol: His face was young, but he was obviously a Hunter. A powerful one, too—probably around A-rank. Unlike the surrounding Hunters, who all wore identical armor as if they had come off a factory line, he also had a red insignia on his shoulder.

hunks.baseline: “You look like you hold a pretty significant rank, so take good care of your men. Let’s save even one more person.”
hunks.sol: “You look like you hold a pretty high rank, so take good care of your men. Let’s save as many people as we can.”

hunks.baseline: When the searing heat swept through the area, only dozens of monster corpses remained.
hunks.sol: Searing heat swept through the area, leaving behind dozens of monster corpses.

hunks.baseline: Humans and monsters. Monsters and humans.
hunks.sol: Humans against monsters. Monsters against humans.

hunks.baseline: A battle of killing and being killed began. I pulled White Flame from where it was deeply embedded in the ground and swung it.
hunks.sol: The battle to kill or be killed began anew. I pulled White Flame from where it was embedded deep in the ground and swung it.

hunks.baseline: This wasn’t half water and half fish. Monsters filled every direction.
hunks.sol: Forget half water, half fish. Monsters packed every inch of the battlefield.

hunks.baseline: A crescent of Force extending from the spearhead brushed against a tightly packed cluster of monsters.
hunks.sol: A crescent of Force shot from the spearhead and swept through a tightly clustered group of monsters.

hunks.baseline: Under normal circumstances, I would have let such notifications go in one ear and out the other, or simply ignored them.
hunks.sol: Under normal circumstances, I would have let them go in one ear and out the other or simply ignored them.

hunks.baseline: “These things couldn’t possibly be…”
hunks.sol: “Don’t tell me these things are…”

hunks.baseline: —Ah, that’s right. Wicked human! Such a powerful undead army!
hunks.sol: —Ah, that’s right. Wicked human! What a powerful undead army!

hunks.baseline: There were still quite a few living monsters, but more than half of them were undead. Altogether, they formed a massive army numbering nearly two thousand.
hunks.sol: There were still quite a few living monsters, but more than half were undead. Altogether, they formed a massive army nearly two thousand strong.

hunks.baseline: “Do you want to be annihilated like that thing just now? Beautiful, magnificent, and heroic?”
hunks.sol: “Want to be erased like that thing just now? Beautifully, magnificently, and heroically?”

hunks.baseline: The Skeleton Warlord, who had briefly forgotten its current situation, hurriedly added:
hunks.sol: The Skeleton Warlord, who had briefly forgotten its situation, hurriedly added:

hunks.baseline: “The Lich. Did that bastard personally come here?”
hunks.sol: “The Lich. Did that bastard come here in person?”

hunks.baseline: —Hmm. If you mean the Lich in that holographic video you showed me last time, then probably not.
hunks.sol: —Hmm. If you mean the Lich from that holographic video you showed me last time, then probably not.

hunks.baseline: A massive iron club passed dangerously close to my shoulder and smashed into the ground. It was an ordinary ogre, still carrying the vitality of a living creature.
hunks.sol: A massive iron club passed within inches of my shoulder and smashed into the ground. It was an ordinary ogre, still carrying the vitality of a living creature.

hunks.baseline: The ogre struck in the chest by the Flame Divine Palm spurted dark green blood from all seven orifices.
hunks.sol: The Flame Divine Palm struck the ogre in the chest, sending dark green blood spurting from its seven apertures.

hunks.baseline: I passed the collapsing bulk and brought White Flame down at an angle.
hunks.sol: I passed its collapsing bulk and brought White Flame down at an angle.

hunks.baseline: Space itself was cut apart, and the bodies of the monsters caught within it were chopped to pieces.
hunks.sol: Space itself split apart, and the monsters caught within it were chopped to pieces.

hunks.baseline: Leaving behind the Chinese Hunter who stared blankly at me while covered in blood and bodily fluids, I clenched my fist.
hunks.sol: Leaving behind a Chinese Hunter who stared blankly at me, drenched in blood and bodily fluids, I clenched my fist.

hunks.baseline: Extreme heat raced into my fist, then shot forward.
hunks.sol: Extreme heat surged into my fist, then blasted forward.

hunks.baseline: Alongside the foul stench of burning flesh, the few monsters that had somehow survived shrieked in pain.
hunks.sol: The few that somehow survived shrieked in agony amid the foul stench of burning flesh.

hunks.baseline: The destructive power was enough to make both monsters and Hunters forget to fight for a moment.
hunks.sol: The destructive power made monsters and Hunters alike forget to fight for a moment.

hunks.baseline: —His control over the undead is a notch below mine. Wahaha! Legion! This commander has missed you!
hunks.sol: —His control over the undead is a notch below mine. Wahaha! My legion! This commander has missed you!

hunks.baseline: As I pondered the question, a thought suddenly flashed through my mind, and I stopped dead.
hunks.sol: As I considered the question, an idea suddenly flashed through my mind, and I stopped dead.

hunks.baseline: “Disappear or talk.”
hunks.sol: “Talk, or be erased.”

hunks.baseline: “That bit about controlling the undead.”
hunks.sol: “That part about controlling the undead.”

hunks.baseline: —Isn’t that obvious? This commander is a Skeleton Warlord. Compared to them, of course I’m… Huh?
hunks.sol: —Isn’t it obvious? This commander is a Skeleton Warlord. Compared to them, of course I’m… Huh?

hunks.baseline: The Skeleton Warlord must have reached the same conclusion I had. I swallowed dryly before bringing it up casually.
hunks.sol: The Skeleton Warlord must have reached the same conclusion I had. I swallowed hard and broached the subject casually.

hunks.baseline: “Try it. Do that.”
hunks.sol: “Try it. That thing you do.”

hunks.baseline: “Do it, or disappear.”
hunks.sol: “Do it, or be erased.”

hunks.baseline: At that moment, the undead monsters in the middle of their fierce battle suddenly froze in place.
hunks.sol: At that moment, the undead monsters locked in fierce battle suddenly froze in place.
